name: Minamoto no Yoritomo
source:
Minamoto no Yoritomo is the leader of the Kamakura Genji clan. He is the half-brother of Yoshitsune, who will later establish a samurai-centered world and become the first shogun.

He is a stern man with few emotional ups and downs. Because of his ability to see the big picture, he may appear to be a man who does not know what he is thinking from the outside. However, he is a very smart man with a solid cause.
